actions.diagnosis: The implementation reads row values before validating CSV headers.
actions.action: Validate required columns immediately after DictReader initialization.
actions.reverification: Run the missing-column CSV case and expect a clear error.

actions.diagnosis: The implementation lets ValueError escape as a Python traceback.
actions.action: Catch numeric conversion errors and return a clear row-level message.
actions.reverification: Run the bad-revenue CSV case and expect an Invalid revenue error.

actions.diagnosis: The implementation accepts an empty month and aggregates it as a blank key.
actions.action: Strip and validate month before adding revenue to totals.
actions.reverification: Run the missing-month CSV case and expect a Missing month error.

actions.diagnosis: The implementation lets FileNotFoundError escape as a Python traceback.
actions.action: Catch FileNotFoundError and return a clear file-not-found message.
actions.reverification: Run the missing-file case and expect a File not found error.
